input.label: bug
input.reply:
This is a valid issue. vitest dynamically imports coverage providers (code in src/utils/coverage.ts lines 32-33), but unlike @vitest/browser-* and @vitest/ui, these coverage packages aren't declared as optional peer dependencies in packages/vitest/package.json.

This causes runtime failures in pnpm's strict isolation mode (default in pnpm 10) where packages must be explicitly declared. The fix is straightforward: add @vitest/coverage-v8 and @vitest/coverage-istanbul to both peerDependencies and peerDependenciesMeta (marked optional) in packages/vitest/package.json, matching the existing pattern for browser and UI packages.
